visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen layout. The top half features a man with glasses wearing a black t-shirt, sitting in a black 'noblechair' gaming chair. He is laughing and wiping his eyes as if moved to tears. The bottom half shows a panel of three people (two men and one woman) sitting behind a desk with Acer Predator laptops and Evian water bottles. (2) A sharp cut transitions to a young man with short-cropped hair and glasses, wearing a jersey with multiple logos. He is looking down at papers in his hand and speaking earnestly while gesturing with his right hand. The background is a clean, bright indoor office setting. (3) The scene cuts back to the man in the top panel (Joeman), who is now pointing towards the camera with his right hand while speaking. He sits in the same black gaming chair against a background of shelves filled with colorful toys and figurines. (4) Cut to a different man wearing a blue and black esports jersey sitting at the desk with a laptop in front of him. He is speaking and looking slightly off-camera, with a shelf of figurines visible behind him. (5) The final sequence returns to the man in the black t-shirt (Joeman). He is speaking directly to the camera with high energy, occasionally gesturing with his hands. Behind him, shelves are packed with collectibles like Gundam models. The video ends with a classic SMPTE color bars screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 成為世紀帝國孔子 持續地超越巔峰. [Subtitle]: 講著講著有點想哭啊 感動. [Variety]: QQ. [Logo]: noblechair. (2) [Subtitle]: 能不能繼續往世紀2這條路走. 如果我繼續做的話 其實我連我自己都養不活. 在當兵的期間 就韋恩就剛好找上了我. 我就加入這個團隊. 繼續往世界更頂端的目標去前進. (3) [Subtitle]: 也有一個明確的目標想要達成. 只是因為現實的考量 也不一定能夠順利. 現在終於有一個 可以圓夢的機會. (4) [Subtitle]: 補充一下，因為我們贊助商常也是跟我說. 二十年前他在世紀帝國的產業裡. 真的也有冠軍選手. 但是真的環境不允許. (5) [Subtitle]: 以前我們的遊戲的環境 不允許很多人做這樣的事情. 現在我們已經成為 造就環境的人. 大家就努力 往上爬吧. 成為 新的 世紀. 跟孔子齊名的 還有... 沒有魄力.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to highlight the evolution of the gaming industry in Taiwan through personal success stories. It uses an emotional interview segment to contrast past hardships where gaming was discouraged with current success where the speakers have become 'environment creators'. The intent is to inspire viewers and showcase the professionalism of the current esports ecosystem.
